base_member_text: MinDepthFrc*10_SP (L208): the literal 10_SP uses SP as an integer kind parameter although SP is the real kind from PARAM; whether this compiles as intended (integer kind SP) or was meant as 10.0_SP is determined outside this file.

MASK0 masking marks cells with Depth0 < SmoothBelowDepth and their neighbors as 0, i.e. smoothing is applied only to cells DEEPER than SmoothBelowDepth (L143-149); with the default SmoothBelowDepth=-LARGE (L103) nothing is masked. The parameter name suggests 'smooth below this depth' but the code excludes cells below it - intent vs naming unclear from this file alone.

Cross-line: change_percentage is MPI_ALLREDUCE-maxed only under PARALLEL after the increment (L226-227), but the loop-condition check (L177) in the first iteration uses the seeded 1.0_SP (L176); iteration counts printed per rank are consistent only because of the allreduce at loop bottom.

Declared but unused in this file: myint (L72), Ifile, K, K5, K10, K15 (L85), TMP_NAME of CORRECTION (L84), status/req/nreq/len (L89-91, the MPI_WAITALL that used them is commented at L233); itmp1-itmp4, SMALL, tmp2, tmp3 imported at L78 are unused.
Convergence loop cap 'pointcount .LE.1000' (L177) with threshold 0.05 (L95): if not converged by 1001 iterations the capped bathymetry is accepted without warning; no failure flag is set.
